Thanks for the ping, Sean. Marketing + Legal reviewed — we can approve the following approach:

1) GreenWave may reference Redwood's public SOC 2 attestation and link to our public compliance page: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2
2) We can provide a short, pre-approved quote for the case study. Suggested quote (20–30 words):
"Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II attestation and follows industry best practices for data security and operational controls; our public attestation is available on our compliance page."

Notes:

- Attached is a one-page redwood-soc2-summary.pdf you can share (flags what is public vs. confidential).

Sean — you can send the quote to Lisa and include the link + the PDF. Ask them if they want the longer attestation document; if so, route to Legal.
